decisions.decision:
In /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign (adisuja/3-day-tantra-ai-revops-workshop only):
1) Stash the runner's work in progress with a label.
2) git fetch, then merge origin/main into series-deck-finish. Resolve conflicts hunk by hunk with git checkout -m. Never use --ours or --theirs on a whole file.
3) Run the full verify (all probes, check-guides, the kit test), fix any failures, then rebuild the kits with revops-os/build-kits.sh from the merged HEAD and commit.
4) Push the branch, then git push origin series-deck-finish:main as a fast-forward. Never force.
5) Make a clean worktree at origin/main and run deploy-clean.sh. Confirm the live centre's cards and playbook match ?v=abdf8c59, and log the Worker version.
6) Log the rev-list count (must be 0), the main hash and the version.
7) Close T-456's push question as decided here, then pop the stash.
Move the task to review.
decisions.why: Adi approved merging into main on 2026-10-06 and said main must hold the latest. On 2026-10-21 he asked for this same merge, verify and deploy. Pushing to our own repo needs no approval (orchestrator-autonomy). The T-456 yes/no ask is exactly the kind of step he banned.
